about: Easy swaps of Nordic pieces for held native ones of like size and function. place-plan seeds a NEW place's draft.replace from the rows whose `old` the place's source holds (tools/places/draft/io.py seed_swaps, called by draft wholesale on a place's first lay, never on a drafted place). Each row was looked at (search sheet) and passes io.keeps_function; the draft's own check still refuses a Nordic replacement. Keep what is nearly fine, prefer the Tropical Skyrim version, take an easy swap, never laboriously replace (owner, 2026-11-20).
